## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Reference or methodology improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] No confidential, employer, client, customer, or personal data.
- [ ] No internal system, application, table, column, or schema names.
- [ ] No live thresholds, tuning parameters, or population sizes.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, connection strings, or internal URLs.
- [ ] Examples are synthetic and labeled as such.
- [ ] I reviewed `git diff` line by line, including changed content.
- [ ] New or renamed `references/` files are listed in `SKILL.md`.
- [ ] `README.md` and `README.vi.md` stay parallel.
- [ ] `python scripts/validate_skill.py` passes.
- [ ] `npx markdownlint-cli2 "**/*.md"` passes.

The full public-repo rules are in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
